english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when information or a fact is not known or clear.

examples.english: This matter is still unknown to me.

boxes.meaning: unclear, not clearly written or explained

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when information, meaning, or a definition is not clear.
Use this all-purpose expression when something is visually indistinct or its facts and status are unclear, rather than when it is specifically hard to understand.
Use this when information, an explanation, or a distinction is unclear rather than simply difficult.

examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 se2 dak1 m4 cing1 co2

examples.traditional: 呢張舊地圖上面嘅資料唔清楚。

examples.english: Your explanation is confusing, so I don't know what you mean.
examples.traditional: 你講得唔清楚，我唔知你想點。
